children.value: Overview

We are hiring a Full-stack Web Developer. Headquartered in Los Angeles, California, Right Balance provides top-tier technology talent for innovative companies in the US. We’re in the top 50 companies to watch in LA.
Engagement Details

Our client is a venture-funded fintech building a new global payments platform with a simple, built-in escrow mechanism to safeguard smaller business transactions (< $250k) from fraud and loss. Of the $6.9T US import/export payment volume, 2/3 go unprotected because current payment protection products like letters of credit are too complex and expensive for SMBs. 9 out of 10 SMB owners constantly worry about fraud and loss because non-payment or non-delivery would be devastating to business survival. The client is partnering with banks to make their "escrow pay" solution available for millions of small businesses
Role:
We are seeking skilled engineers with fintech experience who are passionate about building secure and easy to use technology. This is a key early role in our engineering team who will have an opportunity to build core pieces of our technology and see the value delivered to our small business customers.
Candidates must be able to thrive in an early-stage startup. This means a high degree of ownership and responsibility in a less-structured and fast-changing environment.
This is a US remote position which reports directly to the CTO. Get in on the ground floor of a growing fintech startup. Work in a collaborative, supportive, productive work environment
Responsibilities:
Build and maintain new full-stack functionality in our web application (TypeScript, React, Nest.js / TypeORM / Express, AWS)
Collaborate with product design, customer success, and QA to develop a great experience for our users
Apply best practices for secure, testable, and scalable code to continually improve our technology
Ownership in the delivery of our platform to users, including participation in an on-call schedule (issues are infrequent)
Remote with PT overlap.
What’s in it for you
Learn and evolve your skills using the latest and greatest technology tools in a rapidly growing company.
Learn from the best people around you. We constantly challenge the status quo and invent new ways of building a great product.
Work on challenging problems, innovate, and positively impact many people's lives while having fun doing it.
100% remote. Work anywhere, whether it is remotely in the comfort of your home, in a shared co-working space, in an RV on the beach, or while being a nomad in another country.
Required Qualifications
Upper-intermediate to fluent speaking and writing English. Able to have a real-time conversation.
3+ years of full-time hands-on total software development experience.
2+ years of full-time hands-on React experience.
2+ years of full-time hands-on Typescript experience.
2+ years of full-time hands-on Backend Javascript  experience.
3+ years of full-stack web development experience
Specific experience with: TypeScript, React, SCSS, Express
Self-starter with proactive critical thinking
Strong communication skills - essential in a fully-remote team
Commitment to quality and continuous improvement
Interest in learning about security (SOC 2 compliant) and global payments technology
Nice to haves
Experience building a web app for business users
Fintech experience
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent demonstrated ability.
Frequently Asked Questions
What are your typical clients?

The majority of our clients are venture-backed startups at the growth stage. Usually, at this stage, the company already achieved a product-market fit and is looking to expand rapidly. That’s where we bring the best engineering practices, strong architecture, the latest technologies, and consistent processes to help companies scale.
What is the length of your engagements?
Most of our long-term full-time engagements last multiple years. It allows you to evolve your career with the client company taking on more responsibilities.
What’s your company size?

The Right Balance team is 60+ engineers going to 100+ by the end of the year. The current client size team is 7+ people. The timing is great to be a part of a rapidly growing team making meaningful contributions.
What happens if the engagement is completed?
Most of our engagements are long-term in nature. That said, if the current engagement is ramping down, we’ll present you with more long-term opportunities to transition into.
What are your core values?
Client First: we only win when our clients win. We treat client challenges as our own.
Ownership: we embrace responsibility, taking on challenges, getting them to completion, and enjoying getting things done.
Quality: we’re passionate about achieving quality outcomes by applying meticulous attention to detail.
